CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_commercial_price_rules_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.commercial_audit_log (usuario_id, partner_id, order_id, acao, dados_anteriores, dados_novos)
  VALUES (
    auth.uid(),
    COALESCE(NEW.partner_id, OLD.partner_id),
    NULL,
    'price_rule_' || lower(TG_OP),
    CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(OLD) END,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(NEW) END
  );
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_commercial_price_rules_producer_inert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.buyer_scope = 'customer' AND COALESCE(NEW.active,true) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCER_DIRECT_NOT_ENABLED' USING ERRCODE='P0001';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
